launches.body:
## **DeepAware - Automation for next-gen AI data centers**

👋 Hello world! Are you ready to embrace a much more efficient AI infrastructure? Check out [DeepAware](http://deepawareai.com/) / [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/deepaware/):

https://youtu.be/mywozPhOAnA

TL;DR

1. DeepAware AI brings Google- and Amazon-level technology to any data center, making them more secure, efficient, and autonomous.
2. Our reinforcement learning scheduler, real-time market integration, and robotics cut energy waste by up to 30% while ensuring 24/7 uptime.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92985&key=user_uploads/2760576/4188b3ad-71bd-4af7-a52d-eac733f67211)

**Problem**

1. With AI workloads surging, the data center industry is booming—global capacity is expanding rapidly, and the market is projected to hit **$1 trillion by 2030**
2. Data centers waste 20–30% of energy due to siloed tooling and manual controls.
3. Hyperscalers like Google and Amazon solve this with custom AI, but mid-market operators lack access to those technologies.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92985&key=user_uploads/2760576/c08c6a9b-22d9-4ffa-830a-c828ce7597a5)

**Solution**\
DeepAware brings Google- and Amazon-grade AI controls to any data center:

1. **RL Scheduler** optimizes GPU workload placement for power, performance, and cost.
2. **Real-Time Market Integration** shifts workloads to low-price windows and supports demand-response programs.
3. **Unified Dashboard** for one-click policy tuning, automated alerts, and “what-if” scenario testing.
4. **Autonomous Robotics (coming soon)** for remote “robot hand” inspections, cable swaps, and maintenance—enabling 24/7 physical operations with minimal on-site staff.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeWFdq7APkR0uqewAgWtXeKANKr7EDV1KIz0diikWoGKDlTmA6bqIP_-8vNP0V4Fp9d0il-oEnk8u4uCkO_usPJd4xVHtCOifCEAgMO4muD-Dh7s_sFDGyNnR8YeClKD71vLBoOeA?key=Ok6o8HSu--upaY5wBSe41Q)

**Our Team:** 

1. We are both second-time founders. We spent 3 years together building our first company providing second-level energy optimization for dozens of factory.

**Traction:**

1. **6-digit agreement** with a major 30 MW+ data center operator to use our system.
2. **Simulation results** show 15% energy savings.
3. **Industry validated** through Green AI Summits at Harvard with industry leaders from Oracle and Meta AI.

**Ask:\
We’re looking for:**

1. **Data center operators** (and people in the AI infra sector) interested in piloting AI-driven optimization.
2. **AI/ML researchers** tackling real-world control problems.

Got feedback or want to pilot? Reach out: 👉 [jerry@deepawareai.com](mailto:jerry@deepawareai.com) or [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jerryh01/) visit http://deepawareai.com/.
